webster.text: Verbosity; use of many words without necessity; superabundance of words.

example.quote: has oeen said of corruption, of tlie purse and the sword, and of the danger of giving powers, is not supported bj principles or fact ; that it is mere verbiage and idle declamation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 27, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
